name: Stillsmith
subtitle: Pull stills out of any video
description: Unsigned Stillsmith builds for signing with Feather.

apps.name: Stillsmith
apps.subtitle: Pull stills out of any video
apps.localizedDescription: Mark frames while a video plays, then save every one of them to your photo library at the video's own resolution. Videos can be chosen in the app or handed over from the share sheet, Files, AirDrop and stillsmith:// links.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Stillsmith saves the frames you extract to your photo library.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Stillsmith reads the videos you choose and removes frames from your library when you delete them.

versions.localizedDescription: Version 2.0.0 (build 116) — unsigned, ready to sign with Feather.
